subject: Web Development
title: Svelte: The Disappearing Framework
description: A micro-lesson that makes Svelte: The Disappearing Framework usable.

hook.text: Rich Harris asked: what if the framework did all its work at build time, not runtime?

buildup.text: Svelte compiles your components into vanilla JavaScript. No framework ships to the browser.

discovery.text: The result is smaller bundles and faster performance than Virtual DOM frameworks.

twist.text: Svelte's biggest risk is its small ecosystem. Fewer plugins and libraries exist for it.

climax.text: Svelte proved that the best framework might be one that compiles itself away entirely.

punchline.text: The best framework is the one you don't ship.

quiz.question: When does Svelte do its work?
